text: Brand-align the app theme: seed Material colors from the brand purple

Done in the brand-theme commit. Light: primary=#863BFF, primaryContainer=#EDE6FF;
dark: brand-derived light purple (#CDB0FF) on deep purple containers; tertiary
family derived from the logo blue (#47BFFF -> accessible #00658F/#85CFFF pairs).
Key decision: dynamicColor default flipped true->false — wallpaper-based dynamic
color on Android 12+ was overriding the entire palette, so the brand could never
appear; it stays available as an opt-in parameter (resolveThemeVariant and
ThemeTest untouched). values-v31 splash background = brand lavender. Verified:
tests+lint green; visual check on-device is part of the user's T-29 pass.
